paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 6.27, representing a 2.11% decrease from the prior close. Over a window of 22 sessions, the stock has seen a 3.55% increase. There have been 4 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

The subpoena is tied to Project Matador and has resulted in a decline in the company's stock price.
